newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar raises number of Shura council seats to 35.
newsitem.headline: Qatar raises number of Shura council seats to 35.

text.p: The Emir of Qatar Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani on Monday raised the number of seats in the consultative Shura council to 35, and appointed six new members to fill the vacant seats, the official QNA news agency said.
The council debates laws and makes suggestions for legislative amendments, but the final decision-making power rests with the emir.
According to an official decree also announced on Monday, "the emir may appoint more members as appropriate for the public interest", QNA said.
